name: Weapon Durability
description: Every weapon lasts {{multiplier}} times as long before it breaks.
author: KSFA

settings.label: Durability multiplier
settings.help: Whole numbers only - these are whole-number columns in the game. 1 leaves it at stock. Capped at x10: the highest-durability weapon in the stock game already sits at the field's own historical ceiling, so x10 is as far as this can go while staying within a defensible multiple of ground the game is known to handle.

patches.sql: UPDATE master_part SET dur = dur * {{multiplier}} WHERE type = 'PTTP_ARM';
